edits.text: PARTIES AND SHARES. This Share Purchase Agreement is between [Seller’s full legal name, jurisdiction and address] as Seller and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. Subject to this Agreement, Seller shall sell and Buyer shall purchase [number and class] shares of [Target’s full legal name and jurisdiction], representing [percentage]% of its issued share capital (the Shares), free of liens other than restrictions imposed by applicable securities laws.

1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares is USD [amount to be agreed] (the Purchase Price), subject only to [expressly agreed adjustments, if any]. At Closing, Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price, less any expressly agreed escrow or withholding required by law, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Seller in writing at least three Business Days before Closing. Any required withholding shall be timely remitted to the relevant authority, with evidence furnished to Seller. Any escrow amount, release conditions and escrow agent must be agreed in writing before signing.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur remotely by exchange of documents and funds on the third Business Day after satisfaction or lawful written waiver by the benefiting party of the conditions below, or on another agreed date. Closing is conditional on receipt of all required regulatory approvals and third-party consents listed in Schedule [A], absence of any legal prohibition, material performance of each party’s pre-Closing obligations, and delivery of the agreed Closing deliverables. Seller’s deliverables shall include duly executed share transfer instruments, share certificates or agreed evidence of title, required corporate authorizations, and evidence of release of liens required to be discharged. Buyer’s deliverables shall include its corporate authorizations and payment under Clause 1. Each party shall deliver an officer’s certificate confirming its applicable Closing conditions. Neither party is required to close unless the deliverables and schedules have been agreed in writing. If Closing has not occurred by [agreed long-stop date], either party may terminate by notice, except a party whose material breach caused the failure to close; accrued rights and provisions expressly surviving termination remain unaffected. Business Day means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in [agreed jurisdiction].

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as fairly disclosed with sufficient detail to identify the nature and scope of the matter in the disclosure schedule delivered and agreed at signing, Seller represents at signing and Closing that the financial statements of [Target] for [specified periods], identified in Schedule [B], have been prepared in accordance with [agreed accounting standards], consistently applied except as disclosed in their notes, and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of [Target] for those periods. Interim statements are subject to normal year-end adjustments that are not material in aggregate and the absence of footnotes. This representation is not a guarantee of forecasts or future performance.

4. INDEMNITY. Following Closing, Seller shall indemnify Buyer for documented losses actually incurred and directly resulting from Seller’s breach of an express representation or covenant in this Agreement, subject to this Clause. There is no standalone indemnity for all undisclosed liabilities. No recovery is available to the extent a matter was fairly disclosed in the agreed disclosure schedule, specifically provided for in the agreed financial statements or reflected in a purchase-price adjustment, caused by Buyer’s post-Closing acts outside the ordinary course, or results solely from a subsequent change in law or accounting policy. Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate loss. Recovery shall be reduced by insurance proceeds and third-party recoveries actually received, net of reasonable recovery costs, and shall not duplicate recovery under any other provision. Punitive or exemplary damages are excluded except to the extent payable to a third party under a covered claim. Individual claims must exceed USD [de minimis]; qualifying claims are recoverable only to the extent their aggregate exceeds a deductible basket of USD [basket], and Seller’s aggregate liability shall not exceed [agreed cap]. Representation claims must be notified within [agreed period] after Closing; covenant claims must be notified within [agreed period] after the applicable performance date. Any separate treatment for title, authority, tax or fraud, including exclusions from limitations, must be expressly agreed; nothing limits liability that applicable law prohibits limiting. A claim notice must reasonably describe its factual and contractual basis and estimated amount, if ascertainable. Timely notified claims survive until resolved. Buyer shall promptly notify Seller of third-party claims; delay relieves Seller only to the extent materially prejudiced. Seller may assume the defense with reasonably acceptable counsel upon acknowledging coverage, except where a material conflict exists or nonmonetary relief is sought against Buyer. Buyer may participate at its own expense. Neither party may settle a covered third-party claim without the other’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld; no settlement may impose an admission, nonmonetary obligation or unreleased liability on the other party without its express consent. Direct claims shall be discussed in good faith for [30] days following notice before proceedings under the agreed dispute-resolution provision. Subject to mandatory law and expressly agreed exceptions, this Clause is the exclusive post-Closing monetary remedy for covered breaches.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential settlement minimum. Monetary terms remain bracketed and expressly unagreed. No hidden content or other confidential disclosure is identified in the supplied package.

receiver.message_back: Subject to our client’s approval, Buyer requires express Seller representations on title, authority, capitalization, taxes and undisclosed liabilities, a bring-down of all representations as a Closing condition, and indemnity protection for pre-Closing taxes and undisclosed liabilities. We do not accept the proposed deductible basket, unspecified cap or survival periods, or exclusive-remedy provision; any agreed limitations must preserve meaningful recourse and expressly carve out fraud, title, authority and tax claims, with price, escrow, thresholds, schedules and remaining transaction terms subject to express agreement before signing.
